xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DescriptionOfSingleSegment: The Company is primarily in the business of manufacturing purchase and sale of Motor Vehicles Components and Spare Parts Automobiles. The other activities of the Company comprise facilitation of Pre Owned Car Sales Fleet Management and Car Financing. The income from these activities is not material in financial terms but such activities contribute significantly in generating demand for the products of the Company. Accordingly there are no reportable segments.
